name: inventory-management-system
description: Complete inventory management solution for Indian businesses

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.clean: cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules dist && cd ../backend && rm -rf node_modules dist
scripts.test: cd frontend && npm test && cd ../backend && npm test
